title: GCD / UMCP: The First Welded Seam Casepack — A Worked Case Showing Earned Continuity Under Frozen Seam Accounting
source_native_claims: Finite return is necessary but not sufficient for welded continuity; a welded object has passed through an accounting seam whose debits, credits, ledger change, budget comparison, residual check, and identity check reconcile under a frozen contract.
Under the unit-rate closure finite return is present but the seam residual fails (returned-but-unwelded); under the calibrated local closure the residual closes (conformant welded seam).
Does not introduce a new Tier-1 invariant, claim a universal return-rate constant, define governance procedure, or stage a domain closure.
